comment: age v1 test vectors from C2SP CCTV (c2sp.org/CCTV/age, 0BSD/CC0), the non-armored ones with an X25519 identity. `file` is the age file, zlib-compressed when `compressed`; `payload` is the SHA-256 of the plaintext.

vectors.name: header_crlf
vectors.comment: lines in the header end with CRLF instead of LF

vectors.name: hmac_not_canonical
vectors.comment: the base64 encoding of the HMAC is not canonical

vectors.name: hybrid_x25519_arg
vectors.comment: the X25519 stanza has a hybrid enc

vectors.name: scrypt_and_x25519
vectors.comment: scrypt stanzas must be alone in the header

vectors.name: stanza_long_line
vectors.comment: a body line is longer than 64 columns

vectors.name: stanza_missing_body
vectors.comment: every stanza must end with a short body line, even if empty

vectors.name: stanza_missing_final_line
vectors.comment: every stanza must end with a short body line

vectors.name: stanza_multiple_short_lines
vectors.comment: a short body line ends the stanza

vectors.name: stream_last_chunk_empty
vectors.comment: final STREAM chunk can't be empty unless whole payload is empty

vectors.name: x25519_bad_tag
vectors.comment: the ChaCha20Poly1305 authentication tag on the body of the X25519 stanza is wrong

vectors.name: x25519_extra_argument
vectors.comment: the X25519 stanza has an unexpected extra argument

vectors.name: x25519_identity
vectors.comment: the X25519 share is the identity point, so the shared secretis the disallowed all-zero value

vectors.name: x25519_long_file_key
vectors.comment: the file key must be checked to be 16 bytes before decrypting it

vectors.name: x25519_long_share
vectors.comment: an extra most-significant zero byte is appended to the X25519 share

vectors.name: x25519_low_order
vectors.comment: the X25519 share is a low-order point, so the shared secretis the disallowed all-zero value

vectors.name: x25519_lowercase
vectors.comment: the first argument in the X25519 stanza is lowercase

vectors.name: x25519_not_canonical_body
vectors.comment: the base64 encoding of the share is not canonical

vectors.name: x25519_not_canonical_share
vectors.comment: the base64 encoding of the share is not canonical

vectors.name: x25519_short_share
vectors.comment: a trailing zero is missing from the X25519 share
